race.description: Carlton & United Breweries- Amazing Forbes Showcase Mdn Plate
race.comment: GREY BELIEF (11) settled just off the lead but couldn't pick up when it mattered last start over 1700m at Grafton. Cherry ripe after three runs back from a spell and this is a far easier maiden than the other three she has contested this prep. C'MON WICKSY (2) is new to this trip but found the line well at the Canberra Acton last time out so it should suit. BELLA PIAZZA (1) comes right into calculations now after some key scratchings. Has shown glimpses of ability without fully putting a full race together. Will find this easier and is in the mix. LITLFELA (3) has been knocking on the door and is another to consider.
